data.short_meaning: One who emerges, or comes forth
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb ‘nataja’, meaning ‘to come forth’, ‘to emerge’, or ‘to be brought forth’. Nitaj is a name of great significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the emergence of a new soul into the world and the potential for growth and development throughout one's life. The name Nitaj carries the meaning “One who emerges, or comes forth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nitaj usually hope their child will grow to embody one who emerges, or comes forth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
